description: Push a local git branch to a Magento Cloud project. Uses SSH certificate authentication — no separate git credentials needed. The branch must exist locally.

local_branch.description: Local branch name to push, e.g. 'feature-xyz'

remote_branch.description: Remote branch name. Defaults to the same as local_branch.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local git repository, e.g. '/home/user/myproject'

name: push_branch
